Roadblocks help us control enemy movements when they approach from multiple directions.

Please combine your Operators' firepower with the Stun Generator on the battlefield to stop the enemy attack.

Be careful of the large number of approaching enemies, but keep an eye on the agile Reunion leader.
The Stun Generator can stop her movement for a short time.

stages.chg:

periodically fire bolts, dealing Physical damage to our units.

Condition:

Condition:

Condition:

Condition:

periodically fire bolts, dealing Physical damage to our units.

stages.chg:
Condition:
The Speed of enemy units is increased significantly.

Condition:
Yeti Squadron units and Frostfangs deal even more damage against Frozen units.

stages.chg:
Condition:

Condition:
7 tiles on the map will no longer allow units to be deployed upon them.

stages.chg:
Condition:

stages.chg:
Condition:
Enemy Oneiros drones have greatly increased movement speed.

Condition:

stages.chg:
Condition:
Medic Operators cannot be deployed.

stages.desc: Learn about the 'Cold' and 'Frozen' status effects.

Condition:

Condition:

Condition:

Condition:
All enemies have increased HP.

stages.chg:
Condition:
All allied units have -1 Block.

stages.chg:
Condition:

This place lacks many of the conditions necessary for life, but the bleached bones and blood trails demonstrate that life has established its own form of order in this place of death.

stages.name: Treacherous City
stages.desc: A treacherous miasma-filled city ruin. We would not tread here unless absolutely necessary. Catastrophe has caused these broken walls and roads to fade from the memories of those who built them, and a curse has befallen this place. The ruined city is a deadly trap, and we find ourselves in its presence.

stages.name: Treacherous Lake
stages.desc: A treacherous, dried, collapsed lake bed. We would not tread here unless absolutely necessary. An enormous concrete dome is hidden beneath the bottom of the lake. An explosion of unknown cause has turned this heavily guarded base into a slaughter ground where it is every survivor for themselves, and deadly weapons unbound by rule or reason are now pointed at us.

stages.desc: This place used to be one of our outposts on the edge of the barrens. Time, beasts, and scavengers have taken their toll, but it is a good starting point for a factory base that can support further expansion into the wildland.
